spec_refs: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN Phase 4 'schema gate refuses every counterexample schema'
SPEC §E: tenant/key columns binary+deterministic collation (refines_necessary); W3 sole full-length (t,key) unique index, NO-PAD; W5 closure over triggers / data-modifying CTEs / FK actions
ARCHITECTURE §3.8 R-DB-7 live check_schema() (binary collations, no citext/NOCASE, partition-key opclass = column's)
spikes/q4-005 counterexamples (PadSpace utf8mb4_bin, second UNIQUE(id), prefix index, ICU level2)
oracles: oracles/schema-gate: counterexample corpus x {static, sqlite, pg}; PASS iff every counterexample is refused with the expected SchemaError class AND every golden schema is accepted (refuse-all must fail)

acceptance.cmd: oracles/schema-gate/run --self-test && ci/engines.sh with pg17 -- oracles/schema-gate/run --self-test --engine pg --dsn @pg17
acceptance.must: self-test PASS: mutants refuse-all (golden rejected -> red), ignore-collation, ignore-second-unique, ignore-prefix-index, ignore-nullable-tenant, ignore-triggers, declared-not-introspected (subject trusts a declared Schema instead of the catalog) each red

notes: Modes: --static (subject receives a Schema JSON, runs check_schema); --engine sqlite|pg (oracle executes DDL on a throwaway DB, subject must introspect the live catalog and refuse). Counterexamples (each with expected error): nullable tenant; tenant/key NOCASE, *_ci, citext, nondeterministic ICU, PG non-C collation, PadSpace; PK without tenant; second unique index; prefix unique index; expression index as arbiter; partition key opclass != column's; trigger on governed table; FK with ON DELETE/UPDATE action into a governed table; generated column over tenant; PG table without FORCE RLS or with a policy lacking WITH CHECK; SQLite WITHOUT ROWID + NOCASE PK; view as collection. Golden schemas: the five lowering-oracle schemas + composite (tenant,id) PK with C/BINARY. Protocol: JSON lines like lowering-read ({op:'schema', ...} -> {ok:true} | {refuse:'<SchemaError>'}).
